name: Andrew Panasiuk
summary: Product engineer and systems thinker who ships products end-to-end – as a peer to product, not a downstream implementer.
12+ years building native Android and iOS apps in code, used by 1M+ people.
Today agentic coding is my default mode. I own the problem and its solution – not tickets: I design the process, agents run it, quality gates keep it honest.
M.Sc. in Applied Mathematics trained me to reason about complex systems – in the AI era that makes me stack-agnostic.
Ready to build new products, bring an AI-native approach into an existing codebase or lead AI adoption in a team.

craft.label: 2012 → before AI
craft.title: 12 years of native apps, written by hand
craft.text: Kotlin and Java on Android, Swift and UIKit on iOS. BLE device sync, offline-first architecture, custom graphics, SDKs, MVVM/MVI, CI from scratch. I know what good code looks like – that's why I can judge what agents produce.

craft.label: now → with agents
craft.title: The process is the product I engineer
craft.text: Spec → prototype → ship → iterate. I frame the problem, decompose the work, set contracts and guardrails, and parallel agent sessions deliver. Agent-first features with LLMs – grounded, tested with evals, cost-controlled.

loop.lead: The development process is a system with feedback. I design the loop; autonomous coding agents run it.

steps.text: I frame the epic and decide open questions
Orchestrator breaks it into Linear tickets
CI, e2e and post-deploy checks as arbiter

loop.footnote: every retro lands as a PR to the rules – the process improves itself

impact.text: users on each of Cync and August Home – smart-home apps where I shipped key features.
vs. ~2-week estimate: 200+ colors unified into a design system across 8 projects, AI-assisted.
Two AI features – grounded chat and page agent – from architecture to delivery in 14 agent sessions.

jobs.about: Interactive CV with an AI chat and page agent.
points: Shipped an LLM chat that answers strictly from CV data: streaming, prompt caching, grounding and prompt-injection guardrails.
Architected a page agent on the same chat: the model controls the site through typed tools, WebMCP-ready.
Designed a multi-agent workflow – orchestrator, up to 3 parallel sessions, strict file ownership, CI as arbiter – packaged as a reusable template. ~263 tests, zero real LLM calls in CI.

projects.name: SpotOn
points: Unified 200+ color resources into a design system across 8 projects with AI-assisted refactoring – 3 days vs. ~2 weeks; simplified dark mode.

projects.name: Cync

Increased code coverage across the codebase: 0% → 30%.
Built complex custom graphics with Jetpack Compose Canvas to drive user engagement.

projects.name: August Home

jobs.about: App for apartment management, built from scratch.

No dedicated QA – owned release quality end-to-end: testing, regressions and stable production builds.
